claim: Jean Zay demonstrates warm-water server cooling connected to the Paris-Saclay heat network for recovery of computing waste heat.
limitation: Existing-facility example; does not establish heat-network access or feasibility for our proposed site.

claim: SDES reports 471 electricity-delivery-point records associated with data centres and 4.3 TWh of measured electricity consumption in 2024.
limitation: Coverage: metropolitan France; delivery points exceeded 1 GWh in at least one year during 2018–2024. Delivery points are not necessarily distinct facilities; 4.3 TWh is the measured covered total.

claim: The reviewer confirmed that the displayed electricity prices match Eurostat nrg_pc_205: 2025-S2, band IG (≥150,000 MWh/year), EUR/kWh, excluding VAT and other recoverable taxes and levies (X_VAT). France: €0.0614/kWh; Germany: €0.1307/kWh; Sweden: €0.0644/kWh.
limitation: National non-household reference prices, not site quotations. The reviewer clarified that the IC-band screenshot was attached in error.

claim: Jülich provides a German HPC reference describing direct warm-water cooling at data-centre level and waste-heat reuse at campus level.
limitation: 2023 infrastructure reference; does not verify water availability, permits or performance at a new site.

claim: NSC demonstrates the use of district cooling for Swedish HPC facilities.
limitation: Facility-specific, undated operator description; not evidence that equivalent cooling capacity is available for this proposal.
